title: Use-evidence instance (OTCS-0007)
description: One candidate instance of entry use, vocabulary use, or an instrument decision, with the facts a qualification ruling needs. The file is public and challengeable; rulings on contested instances belong to a qualified standing determination (OTCS-0008), never to this schema. Conservative counting is the recompute's job: an instance counts only when ruled QUALIFIED, and an instance never ruled on counts as not qualifying.

instance_id.description: Stable id, assigned in file order, never reused.

line.description: The OTCS-0007 line this instance is a candidate for. Lines are counted apart and never collapsed (NON-GOALS.md §2, §5).

party.description: The party as they publicly identify — a handle is fine, a name is not required (issue #14).

party_artifact_url.description: The party's own published artifact, on their own infrastructure or a public record under their own account. The founder's paraphrase of correspondence never qualifies (OTCS-0007 §2).

claim.description: What this instance claims happened, stated so a stranger can check it against the artifact.

registry_entry.description: entry_use only: the registry entry the decision turned on. Must be an externally self-registered project — the founder's own entries are excluded as targets (OTCS-0007 §1).

entry_dependence_evidence.description: entry_use only: the party's dated statement published before the outcome was known, or the diff in their artifact traceable to the entry — 'would have differed' is otherwise unfalsifiable (OTCS-0007 §2).

independence_status.description: EVIDENCE-MODEL.md §3, applied pairwise at ruling time. This field records the disclosed starting point; the ruling decides.

contact_ref.description: If the party was ever contacted about evidence of use: the contact-log entry. The recompute excludes any instance whose contact entry does not predate the party's artifact.

status.description: UNRULED and CONTESTED both count as not qualifying — every ambiguity resolves against the project (OTCS-0008).

by.description: The determination that ruled, by reference — never the founder (OTCS-0007 §2).
